# Network role artwork

Original SVG illustrations created for this portfolio's seven VLAN role cards.
These decorative schematics identify roles; they are not physical network topology diagrams.
No external photos, fonts, or image services are used.

The card interaction adapts [React Bits Chroma Grid](https://reactbits.dev/c/components/chroma-grid)
by David Haz. Its license is retained in [react-bits-LICENSE.md](../react-bits-LICENSE.md).
